scope: 36 newly authored bilingual research intents, frozen before measuring any encoder on this set. Routing retention and explicit memory ranking only; not LLM tool selection or enterprise business acceptance.

memory.text: Halide composition controls perovskite energy bandgap. Bromine fraction and the family selector feed the bandgap predictor; output is in electron volts.
Long duration humid heat exposure degrades perovskite photovoltaic devices. Aging simulation predicts efficiency retention versus time.
Legacy silicon solar cell performance uses thirteen physical inputs. A parameter sweep uses the batch simulator; original scientific predictors must be installed before execution.
The public TOPCon surrogate requires eighteen source-native input fields and returns six photovoltaic performance targets with dataset provenance and domain checks.
Scientific claims need supporting quotations from the local paper library. Search returns existing indexed passages and source citations, not newly invented experimental results.
Before literature can be searched, local documents must be parsed and added to a persistent retrieval index. Directory ingestion creates that index.

Confirmed numerical observations may be displayed as curves or tables. A line chart compares trends; a table preserves rows and columns. Tool result references bind plotted data to actual calculations.
The original narrow and wide bandgap perovskite device models predict photovoltaic performance from thirty-nine inputs. They are separate from the composition-to-bandgap and aging tools.
